privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.owner: Who is responsible for the information (the data controllers): Moses Appleboim and Dan Moskona. To contact us: {emails}.
items: What we collect: in the site's forms, the display name you choose, your message, and your email address if you give it. For a shop order, what is in the email sent from your own email app (name, items, notes and your email address).

Why: to review and answer your message and to handle your order. Comments and questions, and ideas you allow us to share, are published with your display name only, after review. Private consultations are never published.
You are not legally required to give these details; giving them is your choice. Without a name and message we cannot receive your note, and without an email address we cannot answer you privately.
Your email address is never published, never passed to others and never used for advertising. We use it only to answer you.
To stop spam we keep a one-way coded form of your internet address, never the address itself.
Where: messages are stored with Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany (European Union). The site itself is hosted on GitHub Pages.
In your own browser only: the site remembers your language, chosen currency and order list so they stay from page to page. This is not sent to us.
Your rights: to see the information kept about you, and to ask us to correct or delete it. Write to us through the private consultation form or by email.
privacy.ratings: Ratings are anonymous: only a one-way coded form is kept, to allow one rating per project.
privacy.noAnalytics: The site has no tracking cookies and no traffic-analysis tools.
privacy.mail: Where orders and messages go: a shop order is sent from your own email app to our mailboxes, {emails}. When someone writes through the site's forms, we get an email saying so, without your name, message or email address.
privacy.gmail: The {gmail} mailbox is a Google Gmail mailbox.
privacy.videos: Videos: the videos on the site are shown from YouTube (Google). Nothing is loaded from YouTube until you press play; after that, Google's privacy policy applies.
privacy.retention: How long we keep it: a private consultation is deleted one year after our last contact with you. A published comment, question or idea is kept as long as it is shown on the site. Comments, questions and ideas that are not published, and spam, are deleted within 30 days of review.

edit.firstContent: Content editing: sign in with a GitHub access token.
firstContentSteps: On github.com, open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token. Set Expiration to 90 days.
Repository access: only the bubapix repository. Permissions: Contents — Read and write; Pull requests — Read and write.
Copy the token. In “Advanced editing” choose “Sign In Using Access Token” and paste it. From then on this browser is also signed in for on-page editing.
edit.firstComments: Comments and messages: sign in with email and password.
firstCommentsSteps: On supabase.com open the BubaPix project → Authentication → Users → Add user → Create new user.
Email: your own private email that is set as an admin. Choose a password and keep it to yourself. Tick “Auto Confirm User”.
Open “Comments and messages” and sign in with that email and password.
edit.previewNote: This is the test site. Every edit here is saved to the work branch and shows only on the test site. The live site does not change.
edit.onPageTitle: Edit on the page (the easy way)
edit.onPageText: Open the homepage and edit right on it: pictures, order, size, layout, the opening sentence, projects and names. Every change shows at once, with Undo and earlier versions.
edit.signedIn: Signed in for editing in this browser.
edit.notSignedIn: Not signed in for editing in this browser yet. Sign in once through “Advanced editing” with a GitHub token; then all editing tools work.
edit.tokenExpired: The GitHub key has expired or was revoked, so editing will not work. Create a new key (“First sign-in” below) and sign in again through “Open advanced editing”.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: BubaPix is an AI film and animation studio. We want everyone to be able to use this site, including people with disabilities.
accessibility.standard: The Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013, and Israeli Standard SI 5568 Part 1 (September 2023), based on WCAG 2.0 level AA.
done: The whole site works with a keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab to move, Enter to choose, Esc to close a menu or a picture window, arrows to move between pictures.
Every page starts with a “Skip to content” link.
Pictures have text descriptions for screen readers.
The contrast between the main text and the background meets the standard.
The site adapts to narrow screens and to browser zoom, without sideways scrolling.
When a device is set to “reduce motion”, animations are off.
Each page states its language and writing direction, in Hebrew and in English.
There is no accessibility toolbar: the site itself is built to be accessible.
accessibility.tested: In October 2026 we checked 16 pages with an automatic tool (axe-core), at computer and phone widths, and checked keyboard navigation. A screen-reader check has not been done yet; we will update this page when it is.
notYet: Visitors' comments are published as written.
The YouTube and Vimeo video players belong to those companies, and their accessibility depends on them.
accessibility.contactTitle: Found a problem? Need an adjustment?
accessibility.contact: Write to us. We will handle it as soon as possible, and within 60 days at the latest.
accessibility.contactTip: Please say which page, what the problem is, and which browser or screen reader you used.
